meta.title: Related-Party Screening: refused for a user without the Compliance Officer role
gaps: Open or exercise Related-Party Screening against employee data
Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role and compare the refusal or absence
Sign in as a Compliance Officer and verify the action is available
Select or verify an Enterprise tenant when no tenant ID is provided
Observe or record tenant RBAC configuration granting access to additional roles
